phone.notes: Fixes the app crashing at start with a database imported from the original app and a crash when writing a Digimon to the bracelet; a Digimon from the recycle bin can go back to the bracelet storage; Breakdramon name fixed; new Fights today counter; accessible mode can be switched once every 24 hours. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Wild Digimon now appear after a few hundred steps, not a few dozen: each step has a 0.1% chance, and steps taken while asleep or during a pending meeting no longer count.
